page.name: MAIN
page.editor: EasyEDA Pro V4.1.78 in Edge, maximized on a 1280x2568 portrait display

method.capture: screen capture of the maximized Edge editor window (PowerShell CopyFromScreen), cropped 1:1 to the schematic canvas at (265,215) size 660x2030. No upscaling, no interpolation; the editor rendered the vectors at the requested zoom.
method.framing: eda.dmt_EditorControl.zoomToRegion(left, right, top, bottom); each closeup frame was 80 units wide x 246 units tall, matching the 660x2030 canvas aspect (0.325), so the frame is the crop.
method.scale: 8.25 px/unit (660 px / 80 units; 2030 px / 246 units). The editor's zoom readout sat around 800-870% during these frames. The only 16x attempt (40-unit frame) clipped the labels and was discarded.
method.rejectedApi: eda.dmt_EditorControl.getCurrentRenderedAreaImage returns a fixed whole-page PNG (same sha256 regardless of camera: 90c78e1ea240...), so it was not used for closeups.
method.readOnly: only camera commands (zoomToRegion, zoomTo, zoomToAllPrimitives) and read calls; no save/delete/create/modify/clear.

images.role: MCU left pins: black pin names, blue net labels, green wires; the +3V3/VOUT area at the bottom
images.note: The blue net labels (MCU-36/35/... and the +3V3 label) are drawn on top of black pin names; black strokes are visible only at the glyph edges. The green wires run behind the labels at the pin rows. At the bottom the blue +3V3 text covers the black VOUT pin name and crosses the red symbol outline.

images.role: MCU right pins: PA0-PA15 and the MCU-34/MCU-33/MCU-32 labels (W2 area)
images.note: The blue MCU-34 label starts at the end of PA10 (page x 270.5-290, y 795-804) and is drawn over the short red pin stub (x 270.5-275.5). PA10's glyphs (x 253-271) stay readable; the label touches only the last stroke of the pin name. The green wires are on the other side of the symbol body, not under these labels.

images.role: POWER: both wires (y=910 and y=810) and the POWER-A0/A1 labels at the resistor bodies
images.note: The green wires stop at the red component body; no green ink crosses a glyph. Separately observed and confirmed: the blue POWER-A0/POWER-A1 text overlaps the red body outline at its top-left corner (page x 600-660, y 905-915 and 805-815).

images.role: IO: IO-A0 wire + label (U4) and IO-A1 wire + label (U5)
images.note: The green wire ends at the red body of U4/U5; no wire ink crosses the glyphs. Separately observed: IO-A0/IO-A1 overlap the red body outline at the top-left corner (page x 280-340, y 390-400 and 290-300).

images.role: CLK: CLK-A0 wire + label (U6) and CLK-A1 wire + label (U7)
images.note: Same shape as IO: the green wire stops at U6/U7; the blue CLK-A0/CLK-A1 text overlaps the red body outline (page x 600-660, y 390-400 and 290-300).

images.role: title block, label column (图样名称/项目/版本/设计/批准)
images.note: At 8.25 px/unit the labels and the cell borders are clean; no text or wire overlap.

images.role: title block, value column (MAIN, project, V0.1)
images.note: MAIN / dsh-t19-... / V0.1 are separately legible; no overlap with the label column or the cell borders in this frame. The text31/text32 A-box overlap claimed for this area is not visible here; it is not reproduced at this zoom.

images.role: title block boundary: end of 图样名称 and start of MAIN, straddling the cell border at x~404
images.note: This frame only spans the 图样名称/MAIN border at x~404. The A band is x 560-620, which starts 100 units to the right of this frame’s right edge (460), so the frame cannot see it. Corrected after r12t3: this is a framing gap, not a negative result.

Corrected after r12t3: 0.734 comes from 660 px / 899 units, so the sheet renders 660x1370 px inside the 660x2030 crop; the remaining ~660 px is empty canvas below the sheet. The earlier entry read as if the 2030-tall crop were the page, which the arithmetic contradicts (2030/1866.88 = 1.087).
images.role: camera restore proof: zoomToAllPrimitives() fit the full page back into the canvas

wireThroughGlyph.mcu: 有候选（导线在标签后方）：the green wires run at the label baseline on the left pins; 18 rows carry green ink inside the label band (1494 px). Corrected after r12t3: the black glyphs under the blue labels are the pin numbers, not the pin names (see r2t1). At the right pins the green wires are on the far side of the symbol body.
wireThroughGlyph.power: 无候选：the green wires terminate at the resistor body; no green stroke crosses a glyph.
wireThroughGlyph.title: 无候选：no wires in the title block; text and borders are clean.
wireThroughGlyph.summary: The strict class 'wire ink through a glyph/symbol outline' is confirmed only at the MCU left pins, where the wire passes behind the net label. POWER/IO/CLK are clean for the wire itself.

labelOverlap.where: MCU left labels cover pin names; MCU right labels sit on the red pin stubs; POWER/IO/CLK labels overlap the red component outlines; +3V3 overlaps VOUT and the symbol outline.
labelOverlap.coordinates: MCU left: page x 210-237, y 898-910 (label and pin name share the bbox); MCU right: PA10 x 253-271, MCU-34 x 270.5-290, y 795-804; POWER: x 600-660, y 905-915 / 805-815; IO: x 280-340, y 390-400 / 290-300; CLK: x 600-660, y 390-400 / 290-300. All approximate, mapped at 8.25 px/unit.

aBox.claim: the title block shows a text31/text32 overlap band (图样名称 vs MAIN)
aBox.result: not covered by any 8.25 px/unit frame in this set
aBox.evidence: r12t1-titleA.png covers x 380-460; the A band is x 560-620 and the 图幅 cell border sits at 590. The frame stops 100 units short, so it can neither confirm nor refute the claim.
aBox.note: Corrected after r12t3. The tail overflow is visible in r12t2-abox-tail.png, which frames the 540-620 span; the guide keeps the A box open until the host rules on it.

w1w2.question: does the blue net name press the pin-name text or the wire?
w1w2.answer: Superseded by r2t1. These frames could not separate the two: the black strokes visible at the edges of the blue labels are the pin numbers, and the pin names sit elsewhere.

evidence.leftPins: the black glyphs interleaved with the blue MCU-36/35/... text are digits (pin numbers), not letters.
evidence.rightPins: PA10 is fully readable and the blue label starts at its right edge, over the stub.
evidence.powerPin: the blue +3V3 label does cover the black VOUT pin name and the red body outline.

w1w2.verdict: not decisive; replaced by the r2t1 adjudication, which finds 压引脚编号 at W1, 压导线 at W2, and 压引脚名 only for the net-flag name over PB10.

limits: The page-coordinate ranges are the requested zoomToRegion frames; the crop is the 660x2030 visible canvas at 8.25 px/unit, so the frame and the crop coincide. Coordinates of individual glyphs are read off the image and are approximate to ~1 unit.

W1 (210,795) and W2 (390,795) were later pinned to their attributes (attr111, attr102) in r2t1; this file's per-group wording is superseded there.
getCurrentRenderedAreaImage is a fixed whole-page image in this editor build and could not provide the closeups; all closeups are screen captures of the vector renderer, not upscaled.
overall: 有候选（网名压引脚编号/引脚名/引脚线/器件轮廓）；严格意义上的导线穿字未定：左侧的绿线只在标签基线处经过（18 行、1494 px），W2 的标签只在 bbox 边缘擦过一根导线。导线类仍为判不了，见 r2t1。
